title: GAME DESIGN HELP!!
author: Beginning-Sign1916
selftext:
Really need help around guys so this is my project after a month of working on it using claude. Features are good still working on fine tuning but graphics are really ugly and not what I wanted. Will appreciate if anyone here could point me to the right direction of getting proper good decent looking models and enviornment assets generation guide or prompts. This is a three.js game

https://preview.redd.it/ktipdl1qmgkh1.png?width=322&format=png&auto=webp&s=585bf219f128469ab8c544239b32aec737abacf6

comments.author: Street-Vermicelli800
comments.body: for the prompt ，define the art style once(low-poly/stylized,proportions,texture style,color palette,level of detail),and keep that same style across all the assets imo

replies.author: Beginning-Sign1916
replies.body:
I did prompt it that way but the thing is still it looks ugly. And what I am trying to achieve is this concept instead which is also a simple design. 

https://preview.redd.it/mhrs4jstzgkh1.png?width=286&format=png&auto=webp&s=2effeaf89869fa77aae65b51097211f0a9b9b30d

comments.author: CommercialDoubt4628
comments.body: Maybe grab one model that’s close to the style you want and make that single asset look good in Three.js first?
